reviews.text: Super professional, empathetic and helpful doctor
Exquisite person, kind, polite and professional. Thanks to the doctor I feel less alone in managing my dog.

A special thanks to Dr. and Mrs. Tisci for their humanity, empathy, and generosity. Well-trained professionals and animal lovers, we immediately felt understood and received emotional support during one of the most difficult times of our lives. We would choose the Tisci practice a hundred times over. Heartfelt thanks for everything, also from Romeo.

Dr. Tisci has been treating my animals for many years, and I can say that, in addition to being a serious and dedicated professional, he is truly a special person. He carries out his work with love and deep dedication, and with his humanity, he brings comfort and positivity to pet owners. I have great respect and admiration for him.

Beyond his courtesy and helpfulness, the doctor is very knowledgeable, and what matters most is that he solved a problem with my furry friend that other vets couldn't.
If you have a problem, go to Dr. Tisci without hesitation.

I write this review with all my admiration and gratitude for the kind Doctor Carmine.
Let me begin by explaining that a few weeks ago I discovered that my 15-year-old cat had mammary cancer. Not knowing Doctor Carmine, I first went to my usual, highly respected vet (in the Arenaccia area of ​​Naples) and, after various tests and analyses (which cost the doctor €900), I was told that there was nothing more that could be done for the cat and that I would have to wait until she died. The oncologist at that veterinary practice refused to intervene, as the cancer was in its final stages and there was nothing more that could be done. She likely already had metastases in her lungs, but we could then proceed (once the disease had degenerated and the cat would have already experienced immense suffering) with chemotherapy.
Furthermore, the doctor who performed tests, an ultrasound, and a full CT scan on the cat—and the first thing he did when he saw her, and here you can clearly see the shocking situation: the tumor was a ball that had protruded from the breast, clearly visible and with slight evidence of ulceration because it had a visible blood stain—the first thing the oncologist at this vet did was to puncture the tumor ball and perform a biopsy, thus rapidly worsening the spread of the tumor in the cat, resulting in a worsening of the condition in just 15 days.
Fortunately, through a family member of mine, I met Dr. Carmine, and when he examined the cat, he told me she could have surgery and kindly expedited the operation to allow her to be saved before it was too late. In fact, just in time, the ball had ruptured and was bleeding, and that same afternoon I had booked the operation with him, and he saved her. A kitten with tests from a twenty-year-old cat in good health and condition with "no lung metastases." We realize that Dr. Carmine saved my kitten's life. I will thank him endlessly. Kind-hearted people like him are hard to find these days. Other vets are worthy of a lawsuit. I should point out that Dr. Carmine even charged me a fair price for the operation, while other vets are outright thieves.

If you want your furry friends to be healthy and save their lives, go to Dr. Carmine.

Thank you again, with respect and admiration.

I can't give more than 5 stars, even though Dr. Carmine Tisci deserves much more. He treated my 16-year-old dog for a rather serious issue with unique and rare humanity and professionalism. I sincerely thank the doctor and truly encourage everyone to trust him, because they are in safe hands.
We spoke on the phone to get an opinion for my little puppy and he is always very kind, understanding and above all really listening to my countless questions 🙏 Thank you so much ☺️ …

I've known Dr. Tisci for three years and can confirm that, in addition to being a super helpful and human doctor, he is a true professional. He operated on my Kiko, in fact, he saved him. He was so patient with me that I was so worried I bombarded him with messages, but he always responded and reassured me. He's an angel. He does his job only because he loves animals.
The most helpful, competent, and compassionate veterinarian I've ever dealt with. Dr. Tisci is a guarantee of professionalism and a truly special person.

The doctor and his staff are highly professional and competent, and their warmth and kindness are hallmarks. I've brought my pets to this clinic several times, and each time they've handled the situation perfectly. One of the last animals I brought to the clinic was a stray cat seriously injured by a car (it had a ruptured diaphragm), and after a delicate operation, it recovered. I highly recommend this clinic to everyone! Excellent personal experience!

A complete disappointment!
From what I read, I was the only one unlucky. Imagine, he even charged me for the prescriptions for medications he prescribed to treat certain conditions identified by his previous doctor. Today, when I take my dog ​​to the vet, they don't even charge me 50 cents, and if I bring him back for a checkup, I don't even get a coffee. Then, when you go with the dog, they create a dog file listing everything Mr. Tisci did to the dog. You have to remind him what to do with the dog.
The doctor is kind-hearted and not at all venal, very helpful and took care of my cat and my dog ​​like no one had ever done before.
A very good doctor and has a lot of love for animals, congratulations
Doctor saved my 3 month old dog congratulations
Congratulations to the doctor, he is very good and very helpful and I am always in good hands with my dog.
